description:
Seonha, the top employee at the male maid café Moe, is secretly filmed one day while smoking in a staff-only area.

Eungeon, a police academy student working part-time at a nearby convenience store, happens to witness the incident and steps in to help, unable to ignore injustice.
To repay the favor, Seonha invites Eungeon to visit the café, but Eungeon flatly refuses.

After that, Seonha starts dropping by the convenience store every day, trying to cross the line Eungeon has drawn between them—yet Eungeon finds himself less and less able to turn him away.

**Original Webtoon:**  
 [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/oisikunare), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/oisikunare)
